data.text: I’ll commit to 10 tons this month too. Luke, I appreciate your generosity, but you deserve a share of the income alongside the rest of us. My family depended on this lake, and I want our village to keep earning from it—not trade a little extra now for leaner months later. Once catches are revealed, let’s check our total and agree on next month’s limit based on the fish remaining. John, will you join us at 10? Luke, would you be willing to take 10 as well?
